objective: Test whether candidate 2's rising button learning curve reaches the fixed offline gate with a longer update schedule while holding data, balanced sampling, architecture, and evaluation fixed.

selection: final epoch only; no checkpoint shopping
sampling: Each batch contains 64 replacement-sampled rows from every combination of room 0x42/0x52 and button class none/A/B.
live_gate: If the offline gate passes, evaluate on a newly frozen development arrival panel, then integrated visible house development. Do not promote without the existing 18/20 and 9/10 progression gates and exact replay.
